proves.claim: the runners registry loader returns a record kept only in a registry-<id>.json in the fixtures folder, merged with packages/runners/tests/fixtures/registry.json.

runners.registry.per-item-files.why: Every new test appending its record to one registry.json made accepted items conflict at merge; per-item registry files never collide.

proves.claim: an ID recorded in two registry files is reported as a duplicate, which fails the complete check.

runners.registry.duplicate-across-files.why: Per-item registry files must not let one ID carry two different records.
